sources.title: Further consultation on leased lines market analysis and various pricing issues - Telecoms Access Review 2026-31
facts: The consultation addressed leased-lines market boundaries and pricing issues
limitations: A pending statement is not final regulation
Wholesale analysis is not address-level service evidence

sources.title: Supporting phone and broadband customers through the cost-of-living crisis
sources.evidence_kind: industry support and affordability policy update
facts: The page summarises Ofcom work on social tariffs and vulnerable customers
It reports that 24% of households switched at least one communications service in 2022
limitations: The evidence is a dated policy update
Aggregate switching does not prove individual savings

sources.title: Telecoms firms must better support customers as record number of households struggle to pay bills
sources.evidence_kind: historic affordability news and research summary
facts: The release reported 29% of customers having difficulty affording communications services
It reported low take-up of social tariffs at that time
limitations: The findings are historical and should not be treated as current
Aggregate hardship data does not establish individual circumstances

sources.title: Project Gigabit network build contract - North Dorset
facts: Wessex Internet received a £6 million contract
The award covered more than 7,000 premises
limitations: Historic contract scope is not current orderability
Detailed planning can change reached premises
